-Added proper interaction with purple triangles.

name: smwsprites-spittin-rex
title: Spittin' Rex
description:
This Rex spits out sprites. Includes Birdo's egg and fireball so it can act like a rex-birdo mashup.

Requested by AmperSam.

name: smwsprites-splitting-eating-block
title: Splitting Eating Block
description:
This is an adaptation of the vanilla eating block with a few fixes and an added split behavior.

The main addition is the splitting, which allows it to split off copies of itself when faced with multiple directions to go in, allowing it to potentially consume all possible blocks.

As part of that, the issue with the original sprite where it would get confused when faced with certainl choices of directions and fly off or go the wrong way has been corrected.

This means that even if you turn off the splitting option it will still always go properly towards a block to eat if there is one.

Finally, once activated this sprite will not stop like the vanilla one would sometimes which lets it be used consistantly in more situations.

Just note that letting too many of these go active can cause black lines at the top from too many block updates, but I staggered them so that each split should be updating blocks on a different group of frames and I haven't had any cases with lines in normal use.

Uses a byte of freeRAM to maintain a count of how many exist, this can be ignored/removed if not using the split option.

name: smwsprites-splitting-mega-goomba-pack
title: Splitting Mega Goomba Pack
description:
This is a pack of 2 sprites, the Splitting Giant Goomba and Splitting Mega Goomba that are loosely inspired by the sprites of the same name in NSMB Wii as well as the Marchin' Milde boss in Yoshi's Island. The Mega Goomba must be spin jumped a configurable number of hits to split into 2 Giant Goomba, which can be hit normally to turn into 2 regular sized Goombas. Look at the README for further instructions.

(Rykon-V73) Small update: Added the 2 .json files for both the giant goomba and mega goomba sprites and added ExGFXAD.bin and ExGFXB0 in the archive. I feel those are better, but you decide.

name: smwsprites-splunkin
title: Splunkin
description:
NSMB Splunkin
Author: Boingboingsplat
Normal Sprite.
Uses Extra bit? No.
Uses SP3.

A Splunkin from NSMB. It's a walking jack-o-lantern! Once jumped on, it will move slightly faster and appear with cracked graphics.

name: smwsprites-springboard
title: Springboard
description:
This is a new disassembly of sprite 2F in SMW - Springboard.

It comes with some cool features, check out readme for more details.

Credit is optional.

name: smwsprites-springboard-on-off-controlled
title: Springboard, ON/OFF Controlled
description: This springboard will have a direction controlled by the status of the ON/OFF switch. When ON, it bounces the player from above; when OFF, it'll bounce the player sideways.

name: smwsprites-springy-bubble-bubble-platform
title: Springy Bubble/Bubble Platform
description:
This is a bubble that can floats on water surface OR moves in a straight line and player can bounce on it OR stand on it like on a regular platform. It'll pop if it comes in contact with with any solid surface.

Credit is optional.

name: smwsprites-sprite-door
title: Sprite Door
description:
A highly customisable sprite door. Using extra bytes, it can have gravity and object interaction, use any palette you want, be closed and/or be only enterable when a blue P-switch is active. If the extra bit is clear, it will use the current screen exit. If it is set, it will use an exit specified by extra byte 2 and 3.
See .asm file for details / further customisation.

⚠ Be aware that since it uses one of the default sprite clippings, its hitbox is a little different from a regular door's.

Special thanks to mario90 and Atari2.0 for helping with the teleport code :)

name: smwsprites-sprite-offsetter
title: Sprite Offsetter
description:
A sprite that allows you to spawn another sprite, regular or custom, in an offset position by the pixel.

Aditionally, for regular sprites that are position-dependent (such as P-switches, Bowser statues, etc.), the properties will be read before the sprite is offset, allowing position limitations to be circumvented.

The latest update allows for up to 4 extra bytes to be set for custom sprites.

name: smwsprites-sprite-respawner-v1
title: Sprite Respawner v1.1
description:
A sprite that you place at roughly the same X/Y positions as another sprite. It aims to respawn the sprite whenever the target sprite is killed or otherwise despawns. This sprite is intended to be used with a sprite such as the Magikoopa disassembly, Lakitu disassembly, or the Boss Bass, but can realistically work with most others.

If the sprite is turned into a coin (i.e. Silver POW, Fire Flower), it'll only respawn when that coin is collected.

Uses Extra Bit: YES
If Extra Bit is set, it will respawn the sprite in the same X and Y positions as where it originally was.
If Extra Bit is clear, it will respawn the sprite in the same Y position, but from a random side of the screen.

Extra Byte 1 controls the timer before the sprite respawns

Extra Byte 2:
Bit 0 (01): Don't spawn if Mario is too close (when Extra Bit is set)
Bit 1 (02): Display smoke effect on-generate (when Extra Bit is set)
Bit 2 (04): Play sound effect on-generate
Bit 3 (08): Use free RAM to disable respawning sprites
Bit 4 (10): Suppress sound effect if Extra Bit is clear

Update: Now SA-1-compatible and uses extra bytes now!

name: smwsprites-sprite-seed-v3
title: Sprite Seed v3.2
description:
Changes in this version are listed in the readme.
This is a carryable sprite that "grows" into another sprite when it touches water (the sprite to become is changable via a define in the ASM).
Enjoy and please give credit if used!

Note: Don't forget to enable sprite buoyancy!

name: smwsprites-sprite-shooters
title: Sprite Shooters
description:
This shooter spawns a sprite of your choosing every so often. You can choose the sprite (custom or vanilla), the amount of it which spawns, the delay between spawns, the offsets, and the randomness of the velocity.

The default shooters spawn coins with a random velocity, to make them look like they're coming out of a pipe, like what you can do in Super Mario Maker.

To configure shooters, open up SpriteShooter.asm and scroll to SPRITE TABLES. The extension byte controls which shooter gets used.

Also includes a custom moving coin, which doesn't overwrite its velocity, and has ground friction. It should be inserted as sprite 07 to use the defaults, but it can be changed to whatever you want. Moving coin disassembly by Thomas.

This is my first sprite, so credit would be appreciated.

name: smwsprites-star
title: Star
description: This is a disassembly of sprite 76 in SMW - Star.

name: smwsprites-star-power-station-add-on
title: Star Power Station (Add-on)
description:
This sprite looks like a tan star. When Mario passes over it, his "star power" (displayed on the status bar on the "TIME" tiles) increases by amount you set (usually 5). When he presses up, Mario will have star power activated for as much time as he has on the star power meter, which then resets itself.
This add-on fixes a error where the sprite would not insert, and lets you now select what button activates star power.

name: smwsprites-static-fishin-boo
title: Static Fishin' Boo
description: This fishin' boo stays in a fixed position, lowering and raising its flame.

name: smwsprites-stationary-magikoopa
title: Stationary Magikoopa
description:
This Magikoopa sits in one place, repeatedly firing magic. It disappears whenever Mario gets near and reappears when he goes away. Unlike the normal Magikoopa, several of these can be active at once and after getting killed (by a thrown sprite, for instance), they do not respawn.

Note that the position of the sprite in Lunar Magic is where its head appears, so it should be placed one tile above the floor you want it to stand on.

Check the ASM file for customization options.

name: smwsprites-stationary-piranha-plant
title: Stationary Piranha Plant
description:
A basic Piranha Plant that doesn't move up and down, based on the disassembly by imamelia.

The extra bit will determine if it's upside-down or not. The first extra byte will let you offset the plant horizontally so you can place them where you wish.

name: smwsprites-stationary-reznor
title: Stationary Reznor
description:
A reznor that stays still and spits fireballs at the player. It acts like a regular enemy rather than a boss.

Requested by Pink Gold Peach during Winter C3 2023.

name: smwsprites-stationary-spiny-swooper
title: Stationary Spiny/Swooper
description:
This is a spiny/swooper that won't move in any way.

Requested by DasFueller.

name: smwsprites-stationary-vertical-flying-bumpty
title: Stationary/Vertical Flying Bumpty
description:
This is a flying bumpty that stays in place or flies up and down only.

Requested by Anorakun.

name: smwsprites-statue-chuck-v1
title: Statue Chuck v1.1
description:
This is a Chuck statue, which the player can stand on. After getting close enough to it (determined by the extra byte 1), it begins shaking, and some seconds later (determined by the extra byte 2) it shatters into a Chargin' Chuck It can have gravity or not, depending on the extra bit.

Use this tweak to have gray shatter particles.

Requested by RobloxNewbie19001.

name: smwsprites-strollin-stu
title: Strollin' Stu
description:
Strollin' Stus are squat, pudgy creatures, somewhat similar to Goombas, that are native to Isle Delfino. They have bulbous noses, high-tucked spotted trousers, and a waddling gait.

This sprite was originally part of andy_k_250's Custom Tweaked Sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards. They were made as a demo of the ability for mikeyk's Spritetool (also inherited by PIXI) to create tweaked copies of vanilla sprites without altering the vanilla sprites themselves, via a .cfg file that does not reference an .asm file at all. Therefore, the lack of .asm files in this download is not only intentional, it is the main idea.

name: smwsprites-stunnable-boo
title: Stunnable Boo
description:
This is a Stunnable Boo (also known as boospEEEN), based on imamelia's Boo disassembly. This variant of the boo can be stunned, and when in the stunned state, will spin out of control for a duration of time before reverting back to a regular boo. You can customize how long the Boo is stunned for, it's X and Y speed when stunned, and other various behaviours (such as being stunned by the P-timers).

See the .asm file for usage notes and customization options.

Credit goes to Jammerjab for the spinning Boo idea and most of the spinning frame graphics (I added 1 extra frame to the rip).

name: smwsprites-sugarstar
title: Sugarstar
description:
A Sugarstar from Super Mario Wonder. It moves in an elliptic pattern which you can configure, and can be defeated via spinjump, jumping in it while on Yoshi, throwing an object at it, or with a star.

I included eight list entries with the only difference being the palette, so make sure to configure the extra bytes at your liking! And, preferably, be consistent on the patterns for each color :P

Requested by CalHal.

Includes graphics original by WonderfulWorld. Give them credit!

name: smwsprites-sumo-brother
title: Sumo Brother
description: This is a disassembly of sprite 9A in SMW, the Sumo Brother.

name: smwsprites-sumo-brother-ex
title: Sumo Brother EX
description:
A version of the Sumo Brother that spawns a highly configurable fire wall. With the extra bytes, you can control how far the fire spreads, how fast it spreads and how long the flames take to dissipate. Additionally, fire will only spread if ground is detected, no longer spawning on thin air like the original.

In the sprite's .asm file, you can also configure how long the Sumo Brother's cycle lasts and his speed when stepping to the side. You could make him extremely quick.

Included is a custom flame cluster sprite. Make sure to insert it and set up the define !cluster_flame_id accordingly in the sprite's .asm file! The cluster sprite is required to allow for up to 20 flames to be on screen at once, unlike the original flames of which there can only be 10. It also fixes the sprite teleportation bug and the extended hitbox below.

name: smwsprites-sumo-brother-s-lightning
title: Sumo Brother's Lightning
description: This is a disassembly of sprite 2B in SMW, Sumo Brother's Lightning.

name: smwsprites-sumo-chuck
title: Sumo Chuck
description:
A hybrid of the Sumo Bros. and Chargin' Chuck enemies.
If stomped, it will take damage like a Chargin' Chuck -- animation included. It can be configured to turn into a standard Chargin' Chuck like some variants of the normal Chargin' Chucks, but by default will continue doing whatever it was doing.

There are a few base customizations through the use of the "Extension" field when inserting the sprite:
- Extra Byte 1 will define how much HP the Chuck has. If set to xFF it will be invincible to stomps/hits from below. If set to x00 it will default to 3 hits.
- Extra Byte 2 defines how far the sprite moves on the platform, from x00-7F. If set to x00, it uses the same distance as the default Sumo Bros. and if set to x01, will not move at all. If the highest bit is set (by adding x80) it will transform into a default Chargin' Chuck (which overrides all HP-related configurations).
- Extra Byte 3 will define which sprite the Chuck throws, from a list. The default values for this are as follows:
--- x00 - Sumo Bros. Lightning
--- x01 - Next sprite in your list.txt.
--- x02 - Exploding Bob-Omb.
--- x03 - Hammer Bros.' Hammer
--- x04 - Spiny Egg
New entries can be created if desired.

name: smwsprites-sunshine-blooper-v1
title: Sunshine Blooper v1.0
description:
This is a Blooper based on its Super Mario Sunshine appearance. It will move around and spit ink at the player. It can be placed in ceilings as well. Setting the extra bit will prevent the sprite from moving. It's quite customizable and features easy GFX remapping.

Requested for the Strongest Sprite Workshop 2020 by FedoraFriday

name: smwsprites-super-ball-n-chain-v1
title: Super ball 'n' chain v1.0
description:
A customizable version of the ball 'n' chain sprite. Features include:

- Adjustable speed and direction (up to 8x or 1/16x the default)
- Activate/deactivate or reverse direction with the ON/OFF switch
- Oscillate like a pendulum (either gradual or sudden reversals)
- Several stock shapes, with support to add your own:
-- Circle/ellipse of varying size (can be made astroid-like)
-- Square/rectangle of varying size (can be made into a cross shape)
-- Diamond of varying size
-- Regular polygon, including star-shaped

See the readme for a more complete discussion of these.

name: smwsprites-super-bob-omb
title: Super Bob-omb
description:
This is a Super Bob-omb, inspired and rehauled from its original japanese code. It behaves like a normal Bob-omb, but it has a wider explosion range.

Includes .cfg and .json files. Tested with SA-1 and the latest version of PIXI.

name: smwsprites-super-ghouls-n-ghosts-gririan-woo
title: Super Ghouls N' Ghosts - Gririan/Woo
description:
Girian/Woo enemy from Super Ghouls N' Ghosts. This sprite can follow the player and spit fire/ice.

Requested by Blizzard Buffalo.

name: smwsprites-super-mario-advance
title: Super Mario Advance 4 !-Switch
description:
In certain e-reader levels from Super Mario Advance 4, this unique !-switch appears. It functions mostly the same as the ones from Yoshi's Island, where it makes outlined blocks solid, but this one can be grabbed and re-used as soon as the timer runs out.
The sprite requires UberASM to trigger Exanimation and decrease the timer. It also comes with a block, and requires 1 byte of freeram.

Requested by edidari.

name: smwsprites-super-mario-bros
title: Super Mario Bros. 3 - Spike and Spike Ball
description:
SMB3 style Spike and spike ball

Green - SMB3 Spike
Blue - Stone Spike (throws spike balls towards the screen)
Red - Fire Spike (throws fireballs instead of a spike ball)
Extra bit - move/stay flag

Requested by CalHal

versions.title: Super Mario Bros. 3 - Spike and Spike Ball
Super Mario Bros. 3 - Buzzy Beetle / Spiny
Super Mario Bros. 3 - Burner (vertical and horizontal)

name: smwsprites-super-mario-bros-smw-themed-flag-flagpole
title: Super Mario Bros & SMW Themed Flag/Flagpole
description:
This is the goal flagpole seen in the original Super Mario Bros and countless Mario games since.

Once Mario grabs the pole, he will slide down, and once both he and the flag reach the base, the level will end. The higher Mario grabs the pole, the more points he gets, and if he grabs the top of the pole, he gets a 1-up.

You can customize what reward Mario gets for grabbing the top of the flagpole, choosing between points, or a 1-up, a new powerup status, or both. You can also set the exit type for the goal flag to be the normal exit, or any one of the 3 secret exits. Both options are controlled with the extra bytes - see the asm file for details, and usage notes.

Includes the original SMB style flag/flagpole, and a Super Mario World themed recreation with an animated flag.

Requires a small hijack to take care of Yoshi interaction.

Update: Added a "stop time" option to the 1st extra byte by setting the highest bit, and added a define for the level end song that plays.

versions.title: Super Mario Bros & SMW Themed Flag/Flagpole

name: smwsprites-super-mario-bros-wonder-rolla-koopa
title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder - Rolla Koopa
description:
A Rolla Koopa from Super Mario Bros. Wonder. It acts like a normal koopa that moves fast and jumps off inclines.

Requested by Blizzard Buffalo.

Graphics by deltomX3. Original sprite sheet can be found here.

versions.title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder - Rolla Koopa

name: smwsprites-super-mario-bros-wonder-serpont
title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder - Serpont
description:
A snake enemy from Super Mario Bros. Wonder that hides in a pot.

It will emerge from the pot when the player approaches it. This pot gives the Serpont immunity to fireballs, but shatters when the player jumps on it, causing it to move faster. Stomping on it again will squish it. Alternatively, spin jumping on it (or stomping on it with Yoshi) will immediately kill it.

If the extra bit is set, it will spawn already moving. Its extended/extra bytes determine its pot tile and its properties, alongside its X speed before and after breaking its pot, allowing for custom "angry" variants and the like.

Additionally, this sprite should be initialized properly when spawned by a generator or another sprite like a Lakitu. See the top of the .asm file for more information.

name: smwsprites-super-mario-land
title: Super Mario Land 2 - Midway Bell
description:
This is a midway bell from Super Mario Land 2. It sets a checkpoint upon contact.

Credit is unecessary. Requested by Yoshin.

name: smwsprites-super-mario-maker-2-tracker-block-v1
title: Super Mario Maker 2 - Tracker Block (v1.3)
description:
This sprite is a moving platform, which changes direction when touching specific map16 blocks.
The blue block will start moving when the player steps on it, and it disappears when it reaches the end of its path.
The red block always moves, and it doesn't disappear.

--- Updates ---
ver1.3 (March 7, 2020)
- Fixed solid interaction from all 4 directions.
- Made the blue block disappear when it reaches the end of it's path.

ver1.1 (July 26, 2019)
- Now it works with the reverse gravity patch.

name: smwsprites-super-mario-maker-bob-omb
title: Super Mario Maker: Bob-Omb
description:
This is a near one-to-one remake of the bob-omb sprite from Super Mario Maker 1. It includes multiple defines allowing you to customize it's speed during and before being kicked,
change the physics of Mario after you throw the bomb and much more, shoutouts to Mellonpizza for creating the bob-omb disassembly and Dtothefourth for the graphics.

Version 1.01
- Added full SA-1 compatibility
- Added some optimizations to the code.

name: smwsprites-super-mario-maker-flying-spiny
title: Super Mario Maker - Flying Spiny
description:
This is a winged spiny from Super Mario Maker. It flies horizontally with slight vertical movement and spawns needles.

Credit is optional.

name: smwsprites-super-mario-maker-midway-flag
title: Super Mario Maker - Midway flag
description:
Super Mario Maker flag with the following features:

a) Luigi GFX flag;
b) It has dynamic GFX;
c) Kaijyuu's Multi midway points patch support.

Video in action: https://youtu.be/r0fjgMdSmxM

Luigi flag GFX made by KingKoopshi64 (KingGeoshiKoopshi64 on MFGG). Link to GFX.

name: smwsprites-super-mario-maker-p-switch
title: Super Mario Maker: P-Switch
description:
This is a remake of the p-switch sprite from Super Mario Maker. These p-switches essentially act as a sort-of carryable platform that can disappear after a short period of time.
Additionally you can also make changes to some of the interactions and physics of this sprite.

Note: Separate graphics are used for the p-switches so that you can tell the difference between the vanilla version and the ones from Mario Maker.

name: smwsprites-super-mario-maker-spike-and-spike-ball
title: Super Mario Maker - Spike and Spike Ball
description:
This is a recreation of Spike (and spike ball) from Super Mario Maker 2.

This Spike stays in place, but then, it will throw a spiky iron ball which rolls on the ground. The spike ball rolls and destroys itself when it hits the wall or every vertical surface. Like kicked shells and throw blocks, spike balls can hit blocks (? Blocks and Turn Blocks) and destroys enemies, except this does not show score sprites. If the spike ball rolls up on a slope, it will roll back down. If Cape Mario cape spins in front of the rolling spike ball, it will bounce back to the other direction. When Yoshi tongues the spike ball, he can’t eat it, but he can spit it out. The Spike and spike ball are both customizable sprites. You can determine the number of seconds of how many spike balls or fast Spike throws, or how fast the spike ball rolls.

Requested by CalHal.

versions.title: Super Mario Maker - Spike and Spike Ball

name: smwsprites-super-mario-maker-swimming-goomba
title: Super Mario Maker - Swimming Goomba
description:
This is a goomba.
It moves underwater in Mario Maker.
It will chase player when player enter a certain range.

name: smwsprites-super-mario-world
title: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island - Numbered Platform
description:
A numbered platform from Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island, found in levels like Don't Look Back (4-2).
It's a platform which allows you to jump on only a limited amount of times.

Can be used as a standalone sprite or in combination with a block. Uses the Map16 tile number for how often you can jump on one.

Read the readme for more details.

versions.title: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island - Numbered Platform

name: smwsprites-super-metroid-firefly
title: Super Metroid - Firefly
description:
This sprite is useful. After all, it brightens barely lit rooms much like in Super Metroid where they're originally coming from. You don't want to kill to many of them.
Be careful, they can still hurt you! And they still die from contact!

name: smwsprites-surface-jumping-fish
title: Surface Jumping Fish
description: This is a disassembly of sprite 18 (surface jumping cheep-cheep), commented and ready to be inserted with PIXI. SA-1 Compatible.

name: smwsprites-surprise-mad-muncher
title: Surprise Mad Muncher
description:
This cute little munchy acts the same as his floating brothers. Except get close and he'll go crazy, chasing you, jumping and spitting fire balls. Known problems: It's sometimes reverts to a normal muncher while in air.
Requested by various people on #smwc.

name: smwsprites-surrounded-bullet-generator
title: Surrounded Bullet Generator
description:
This is a disassembly of generator D6 in SMW - Surrounded Bullet Generator.
Credit is unecessary.

name: smwsprites-sushi
title: Sushi
description:
Recreation of the shark in level 1-A of New Super Mario Bros. DS (despite this, the included ExGFX file is the Super Mario Land 2 shark). It swims slowly until it sees Mario, at which point it speeds up. Does not actually require sprite buoyancy or water, and can work in the air.

By default, it takes five fireballs to kill, similar to a Chuck. It also can't be jumped on, but any other attack kills it instantly.

The included ExGFX file goes over the Dolphin's frames in GFX06.

name: smwsprites-suu
title: Suu
description:
A spider from Super Mario Land that will drop at the player when they approach, then rise back to its initial position.

This sprite was part of smkdan's Super Mario Land sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

name: smwsprites-sweep-blaster
title: Sweep Blaster
description:
This Bill-Blaster like enemy will fall down from the top of the screen endlessly and shoot at the player when they are vertically aligned. It also acts as a semi-solid platform!

It won't shoot if the player is too close, though.

If you set the Extra Bit, it will stick to the right side of the screen, which is a viable substitute for the vanilla Bullet generator in things like autoscrollers. This set of behaviors from the Sweep Blaster is a lot less polite, though, and will shoot no matter if the player is close or not.

name: smwsprites-swimming-cheep-cheep
title: Swimming Cheep-Cheep
description: This is a disassembly of the horizontally- and vertically-swimming Cheep-Cheeps (sprites 15 and 16), commented and ready to be inserted with PIXI. The extra bit determines which of the two original sprites it acts like: see the ASM file for more information.

name: smwsprites-swimming-jumping-fish
title: Swimming/Jumping Fish
description:
This is a disassembly of sprite 47, the Swimming/Jumping Fish that "swims" back and forth and then jumps up (it doesn't require water and will swim through anything).
You can find some customizations in the asm file.

name: smwsprites-swinging-platform
title: Swinging Platform
description:
This is a disassembly of sprite 5F in SMW, the swinging platform.

Note: It's kind of messy, and there are almost no comments *because* the code was so messy. If anyone can actually figure out what even half the stuff in here actually does and would want to comment and resubmit it, be my guest.
Note 2: USE THE NO SPRITE TILE LIMITS PATCH if you want this sprite to show up correctly. I can't explain or diagnose it, but when you don't, the graphics sometimes get messed up (and not via missing tiles, either)...and sometimes they don't. I don't know what causes the glitches, but they don't seem to happen when the patch is utilized.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

name: smwsprites-switch-controlled-grey-rotating-platform
title: Switch-Controlled Grey Rotating Platform
description:
A recode of the grey rotating platform (sprite A3) with a lot of new behavior based on a switch, including:
- Ability to control with an ON/OFF switch, or a custom one.
- Ability to switch rotation direction, or to start frozen and then rotate after state change.

Now PIXI compatible.

name: smwsprites-swooper
title: Swooper
description: A disassembly of the Swooper bat (sprite BE), commented and ready to be inserted with PIXI.

name: smwsprites-swooper-eerie
title: Swooper Eerie
description: This is an Eerie which will cling to the ceiling and swoop down when Mario gets close, similarly to Swoopers. Afterwards, it will move in a straight line or in a wave motion like normal Eeries, depending on the extra bit. The 1st extra byte determines if the wave motion starts upwards or downwards. In the asm file you can find various parameters to tweak the movement.

name: smwsprites-tap-tap
title: Tap-Tap
description:
Based on Tap-Tap from SMW2: YI. Tap-Tap is invincible to normal damage, but can be hit by shells and other thrown items and stunned temporarily. It uses the extra bit to determine if it should be a walking or jumping Tap-Tap.

updated by Isikoro
Fixed problem with misaligned footsteps.
Converted to Json file.

name: smwsprites-tap-tap-the-red-nose
title: Tap-Tap the Red Nose
description:
This is that boss from Yoshi's Island in World 6-4, now ported over to SMW. Having already been ported over back in March/April 2010 and used in ASMWCP's World 8, and even being released unofficially, it is now time to put this boss into the custom sprite section, where it belongs.
Information on insertion can be found in the readme. This pack comes with a version that uses the spike hell sprite (original), but also one that doesn't. Requires the No more sprite tile limits patch.

Updated so graphics no longer need to be manually inserted with a patch.

Tester's note: When the lava is placed too low, the level may not end. If for some level design reason the lava HAS to be placed low, use a level ender sprite or such to end the level properly.

name: smwsprites-targeting-ted
title: Targeting Ted
description:
This is a torpedo ted that chases you and explodes like a bob-omb.

Credit is optional. Requested by Super Stiviboy.

name: smwsprites-teleport-keyhole
title: Teleport Keyhole
description: As the title suggests, it is a keyhole to teleport.

name: smwsprites-tenbin-platform
title: Tenbin Platform
description:
from SMB1 Tenbin Platform
change platform width.

Scrolling resets the height
so it is better to use autoscroll oneway etc...

name: smwsprites-thermal-key
title: Thermal Key
description:
This key can actually change its own temperature, enabling (and restricting) access to temperature-sensitive doors. There are 3 states of the key: normal, frozen, and blazing.

Included are the 3 temperature-sensitive doors (GPS blocks).

Read the readme for more info (like coding your own blocks for this)!

Tester's note: Original idea, and nice execution of it!

name: smwsprites-throw-block-sprite
title: Throw Block Sprite
description:
This is a disassembly of sprite 53 in SMW - Throw Block Sprite.

Requested by Hamtaro126.

name: smwsprites-throwaway-pokey
title: Throwaway Pokey
description: This pokey throws its segments at the player in an attempt to hurt them.

name: smwsprites-thunder-lakitu
title: Thunder Lakitu
description:
A Lakitu which follows Mario around the screen and drops lightning bolts. After dropping 3, it'll move down to the ground so that Mario can hit it. It dies by disappearing in a puff of smoke after 6 hits.

Do not use in levels with more than 1 screen. Make sure to set the extra bit when placing it.

See the readme for instructions on how to insert it. Check out both ASM files for customization options.

name: smwsprites-thwimp
title: Thwimp
description:
This is the Thwimp Disassembly included in Romi's SpriteTool by mikeyk but there was an error in that code though that made the Thwimp only jump straight up and straight down. That error however, is fixed here and works perfectly.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

Includes original and modified versions, where modified version contains some new features. Check ASM for more info.

name: smwsprites-thwimp-thwomp
title: Thwimp Thwomp
description: This is a Thwomp that jumps just like a Thwimp.

name: smwsprites-thwomp
title: Thwomp
description:
This is a disassembly of sprite 26 in SMW - thwomp.

Comes with On/Off and mini versions by yoshicookiezeus.

On Extra Bit it'll move only on On/Off switch state, depending on variable.

(I know that there was mikeyk's disassembly, but I felt like making my own version)

Credit is optional.

name: smwsprites-thwomp-pack-thwompsprfix-asm-v1
title: Thwomp Pack + thwompsprfix.asm v1.4
description:
A Thwomp pack with thwompsprfix.asm

I also added the Thwomp Face Flip Fix patch as configs. By default it's turned off.

Comes with:
- Downwards Thwomp
- Upwards Thwomp
- Right Thwomp
- Left Thwomp
- Power Downwards Thwomp
- Power Upwards Thwomp
- Power Right Thwomp
- Power Left Thwomp
All of them can be used as Mad Thwomps (goes up/down right/left and so on once set off) if you set the extra bit.

- Why did you make this tho? There's already another version of all this for download.

I also merged thwompsprfix.asm into this code, so all fixes on that patch are also coded for these Thwomps. I needed this, so I thought maybe more people would also need this.

This is also a single file sprite, so the more you use the more space TM you save (it may not perform as good as using standalone files due to checks and whatnot).

There's also a partial fix to ascension glitch that bothers me a lot with the original Upwards guy. Original code really kills you in unfair ways most of the time when going up. This feature/fix has to be enabled, so read the README.txt for further instructions.

This code also respects what palette row you set on the cfg.

Another minor fix is that they now properly die to shells and whatnot if specified on the CFG. Just set them to interact with other sprites if you wish that to happen. Original code (SMW code) dies to shells according to sprite slot, it's super weird, so I just left the behavior there for you to choose, but more consistent.

Changelog:
Changelog
1.1
-----
Better ascension glitch fix.
Fixed a bug where only the thwomp up would benefit from setting up the fix ascension glitch flag.
It seems I also forgot to add a routine for this thing in the last version lol (related to the ascension glitch flag).
SA1 compatible.

1.2 (Arinsu)
-----
Fixed a bug with the sideways power thwomps as they didn't correctly check for walls.

1.3
-----
Update routine SubVertPosWithClipping to comply to new routine standards.
Added routine SpinPlayerUp (apparently I forgot to add this routine twice lol, it's used in the ascension glitch flag fix).
Added a small bugfix for the ascension glitch - the gitch caused it to be way more lenient than it should once the thwomp stopped going up.
I rewrote the state table / load, so now the old blocks that break on thwomp contact work with this thwomp pack. It should also feel a lot better to create new states.
Fixed a bug with the draw GFX routine where it would reserve one tile more than it should when no angry face tiles were drawn.
Added the Thwomp Face Flip Fix patch as configurable flag (default is turned off).
Extracted some configs and flags so you can get more stuff configured.


1.4 (Isikoro)
-----
Added a setting to look in the direction of movement.
Allows the player to set whether or not to look at the player when he/she approaches.
Converted to a json file, changed the setting RAM from "extra_prop" to "extra_byte", and combined them into one sprite.

name: smwsprites-thwompin-chuck
title: Thwompin' Chuck
description:
An amalgamate of a chuck and a thwomp, combining their powers into one entity.

The "thwomp" part detects x position and the smash, while the chuck adds the jump and the movement. Extra bit gives the sprite more hitpoints, which can be useful for bosses. Extra Byte 1 changes it's x speed (08 by default) and Extra Byte 2 changes it's jump power. There's also a setting which allows the Thwompin Chuck to end the level if the extra bit is set (the "boss" mode).

Unlike the 2022 Mad Scientist version, this one has more compressed graphics and no longer needs custom palettes. If for whatever reason you want the old version, seek the download found in the competition thread.

Please give credit if used. Thank you.

name: smwsprites-time-clock
title: +/- Time Clock
description:
This is a Clock that can add to or subtract from the timer when collected, like in games such as Super Mario 3D Land/World. You can customize the number of timer seconds added/subtracted (from 1-255), the type of effect produced when collected, whether the Clock is solid, and more.
It also handles overflow and underflow - If adding to the timer would take it past 999, the timer is set to 999. If subtracting from it would take it below 0, the timer is set to 0 and the player is killed with a TIME UP!.

See the .asm file for customization options.

Requested by M. Yusuf Suleman.

name: smwsprites-timed-carrot-lift
title: Timed Carrot Lift
description: A carrot lift but is timed.

name: smwsprites-timed-lift
title: Timed Lift
description:
The timed lift sprite from SMW, disassembled and commented.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

name: smwsprites-timed-on-off-switch
title: Timed ON/OFF Switch
description:
This is a block sprite that when hit from below, will flip the ON/OFF switch for a set duration of time, before reverting back. You can set the duration before reverting on a per-sprite basis. You can also set a duration multiplier, and optionally have each switch display a "!" symbol when the ON/OFF switch is about to revert.

Requested by Stivi.

name: smwsprites-tip-the-growing-block
title: Tip the Growing Block
description:
Tip the Growing Block is just a solid block that grows when Mario hits it from below, going from 16x16 to 24x24 and finally to 32x32.

Setting the extra bit will make it skip right from 16x16 to 32x32 and back.

Useful as just a little thing to use when designing levels, allows additional leverage to hit higher blocks in block pyramids or to reach alternate paths.


Pretty much everything is customizable through defines at the top.

Includes simple cute graphics, uses palette A by default.
If you're planning to make your own, the face is the single 8x8 right above the solid colored block.

name: smwsprites-tokotoko
title: Tokotoko
description:
The Easter Island-styled creature from Super Mario Land that runs quickly straightforward.

This sprite was part of smkdan's Super Mario Land sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

name: smwsprites-toothy-s-pipe
title: Toothy's Pipe
description:
A carriable pipe. While carried, Toothy, a piranha plant, comes out of it and kills enemies. You can optionally enable it to shatter specified map16 tiles on contact.

Originally from Super Mario Bros. X.

name: smwsprites-tornado
title: Tornado
description:
Name: Tornado
Author: RealLink
Generator: No
Uses Extra Bit: No
Description: This 16x16 sprite will "walk" along the ground, and spin Mario upwards when he touches it. It doesn't interact with other sprites and is not killable. GFX from TLoZ: OoA/OoS included. Please give credit if used.
Also, thanks to yoshicookiezeus for helping me with the GFX Routine.

name: smwsprites-torpedo-launcher
title: Torpedo Launcher
description:
A disassembly of sprite CA, the launcher which spawns Torpedo Teds. Includes options to stop spawning sprites when the player is near and also to display or not the launcher arm.

Note that while it can spawn sprites other than Torpedo Teds, they won't behave properly due to lacking a "being launched" state.

name: smwsprites-torpedo-ted
title: Torpedo Ted
description:
This is a disassembly of the torpedo ted, it's ready to be inserted with PIXI.

Credit is not necessary but would be nice as I spent along time doing this.

name: smwsprites-toxic-rideable-falling-leaf
title: Toxic Rideable Falling Leaf
description:
This is a variant of Rideable Falling Leaf that hurts/kills player on contact.

Credit is optional. Requested by DasFueller.

name: smwsprites-toxic-timed-lift
title: Toxic Timed Lift
description:
This is a toxic variant of the Timed Lift (Sprite BA), which can hurt or kill Mario. You can customize the time it lasts for (1-9 seconds), the X and Y speeds, and toggle additional behaviours, all with the extra bytes. There are also defines in the .asm file that let you change the palette and tiles used.

By default, the .asm and custom sprite list are preset to meet the specifications of the request. See the .asm file for customization options.

Requested by RZRider.

name: smwsprites-tracker-pipe-cannon
title: Tracker Pipe Cannon
description:
A pipe cannon which recreates the tracker barrel from Donkey Kong Country 3. That means, it shoots the player upwards when entered but it also follows the player until the latter lands on the ground.

Read the ASM file for more information.

name: smwsprites-tracking-flame-spawner
title: Tracking Flame + Spawner
description:
A flame that flies towards Mario. Note that it cannot be spinjumped on. A shooter is included.

The speed, spawn timers and sound effects are easily configurable, as well as the tilemap. By default, it will look right in the Ghost House tileset.

name: smwsprites-trampoline
title: Trampoline
description:
I was thinking about them beanz... so I made this!
A trampoline, a bean bridge, a tightrope... whatever you want to call it!

It's kinda like a wall springboard that's attached on both ends.
Y speeds, the sound it plays, and even if it's bouncy or not can be configured in the .asm file.

name: smwsprites-treasure-chest
title: Treasure Chest
description:
A treasure chest from Super Mario Bros. 3. It can spawn a sprite or put a sprite in the player's item box. Optionally, it can end the level, too (only if putting a sprite in the item box). There is also a version which contains a coin and gives 1-Ups and a version which contains a bonus coin (from the pink berry cloud minigame) and gives 1-Ups.

Non-standard sprites in the item box will have glitched graphics unless you apply Kenny3900's Item Box GFX Fix patch or imamelia's Item Box Special patch.

This sprite makes heavy use of the extra byte. Make sure to check the readme for detailed usage instructions.

name: smwsprites-treasure-chest-with-coins
title: Treasure Chest with Coins
description:
This is a completely original, coded-from-scratch custom sprite. In the game it stays closed, and opens when touched. When opened, moving coins "pop out", one at a time, for Mario to collect. After that it just sits there, open and empty. Readme and GFX included; use SP3.

Give credit if used or tweaked.

name: smwsprites-tricky-magikoopa
title: Tricky Magikoopa
description:
This Magikoopa's magic will teleport player to a specified destination, either fixed or screen teleport.

Credit is optional. Requested by Anorakun.

name: smwsprites-trigonometric-seesaw-platform
title: Trigonometric Seesaw Platform
description:
This is a seesaw platform which acts similar to the seesaws in Super Mario Maker 2.

Their length is configurable using an extension byte.
There are options to make them bouncy, switch dependent, disappearing, There are also options to make them act reversed, and to make them return to their initial angle. All of the above configurable using extension bytes and the extra bit.

Everything's documented inside the .asm file, plus there are a bunch of defines there giving you even more ways of customizing them!

This sprite's compatible with MarioE's Reverse Gravity patch.

Note: THIS SPRITE IS SA-1 ONLY!
It heavily relies on the SA-1's arithmetic registers, it's unlikely I'll ever make a lorom version.
Please give credit if used.

psst

uhhh... lesson learned: don't give up so easily(???)

name: smwsprites-trouter
title: Trouter
description:
The fish from SMB2 that jumps from the water. It contains a few minor tweaks;
Trouter.cfg - A Trouter that jumps from where ever you place it, doesn't need water.
TrouterStomp.cfg - Same as the first one, but dies when stomped.
TrouterCarry.cfg - Same as the first one, but can be carried
TrouterSpin.cfg - Same as the first one, but can be killed per spin jump regardless whether you can kill it per stomp or not
TrouterBuoyant.cfg - Buoyant Trouter, only jumps when it reaches water.

..As well as the ASM file, ExGFX file, and a Readme in case you don't know how, but want to customize certain things such as disabling/enabling killing via spin jump, and if the sprite can be carried or not.

No credit needed, PM me if you encounter any (major) errors.

name: smwsprites-tryclyde
title: Tryclyde
description: Here's another element from SMB2, the Tryclyde. It doesn't act exactly like in SMB2, but it spits fireballs aimed at the player, at different random speeds. To defeat it, you should throw sprites at it. Hitpoints are customizable.

name: smwsprites-turn-block-bridge
title: Turn Block Bridge
description:
Disassembly of the Turn Block Bridge sprites (59 and 5A), with options to customize them. Extra bit determines direction (horizontal or vertical). Readme for more info.

To be assembled with Romi's Sprite Tool PIXI.

name: smwsprites-turn-off-generators
title: Turn Off Generators
description:
This is a disassembly of sprites D2 and D9, the "Turn Off Generators" and "Turn Off Generator 2" sprites. (The extra bit determines which one it acts like.) And yes, I know that the code contained in it is laughably small.
Now SA-1 compatible.

versions.title: Turn Off Generators
versions.filename: SMWSDIS - sprites D2 %26 D9 - turn off generators.zip

name: smwsprites-tweeter
title: Tweeter
description:
This is the Tweeter from SMB2.
By default, it contains 4 variations; 3 of which are not native to SMB2;
- Red: Moves as the original sprite; performs 3 small hops followed by 1 larger one.
- Blue: Same as Red, but stays on ledges.
- Green: Does 2 small hops followed by 1 larger one. Every 6 hops, it'll flutter upward.
- Yellow: Moves faster, hops a bit more erratically, chases the player, and can hop over kicked shells.

Part of my SMB2 sprite standardization project; a project aiming to perfectly recreate the original enemies while adding new functionality.

Release History:
- 7/9/2023: V1.0 (C3 2023) - Initial Release.
- 7/16/2023: V1.01 - Updated the JSON files to disable the "Invincible to star/cape/fire/bounce blk" flag.

name: smwsprites-tweeter-giant-tweeter
title: Tweeter + Giant Tweeter
description:
The masked bird-like creature from SMB2 that hops while walking. Extra bit determines if it'll be a regular or a giant Tweeter.

This sprite was part of mikeyk's SMB2 Updated sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

name: smwsprites-ultimate-boom-boom
title: Ultimate Boom Boom
description: My entry on the third round of the second Mad Scientist ASM Contest. Based on the SMB3 Boom Boom by Ice Man and Tsutarja, this is an extremely customizable Boom Boom boss that can be configured to have a diverse array of attacks and speeds depending on its HP. This sprite uses 7 extra bytes that should be configured properly; please check the readme regarding that. The graphics for the mini Boom Boom were originally created by P-Tux and edited by me.

name: smwsprites-ultimate-chuck
title: Ultimate Chuck
description:
Customisable Chucks. The first extra byte determines the sprite number of the Chuck you want to spawn, and the second customises a certain behaviour depending on the type of Chuck:
- Clappin': Y speed of the jump.
- Bouncin': Y speed of the jump.
- Whistlin': Nothing at all.
- Pitchin': Number of baseballs to throw - 1 (the number must be between 0 and 5, setting it higher will make the chuck only throw a baseball when he jumps).
- Puntin': Time between football spawns (should be a power of 2 - 1 in hex: $0F,$1F,$3F,$7F...).
- Diggin': Y speed of the rock.

The third extra byte the X speed of the Diggin' Chuck rock
(nothing in the case of the other chucks).
The forth extra byte customises the palette of the Chuck in the traditional YXPPCCCT format, and also if it will be a fire Chuck: FE-- CCC-, where CCC is the palette, E is the bit that determines if it's an exploding chuck (bit set) or not (bit clear) and F is the bit which determines if it's a fire chuck (bit set) or not (bit clear). A fire chuck will leave a trail of flames, whereas an exploding chuck will just explode when Mario is near.

name: smwsprites-ultimate-noob-sprite-v1-3
title: Ultimate Noob Sprite v1.3.4
description: This is the infamous "Ultimate Noob Boss" made by Iceguy. It is now back with a new name that implies it can be used for more than boss fights. It has quite a few attacks and is very customizable. Read the comments in the .asm file for details.

name: smwsprites-undine-boss
title: Undine Boss
description:
This is Undine from Secret of Mana as a boss for Super Mario World.
She flies around the room and periodically summons frostblocks which try to hurt Mario or three icicles which try to impale Mario from below.
Additionally, a tidal wave is present which tries to push Mario around to pull him down into the water.

When the frostblocks hit the tidal wave, they become carryable and can be thrown at Undine to hurt her. The wave becomes faster each time it gets hit by a frostblock.

Make sure to read the readme before using the sprite, as setting it up can be complicated.

name: smwsprites-unidirectional-bullet-bill-generator
title: Unidirectional Bullet Bill Generator
description:
This bullet bill generator spawns bullets from one direction only, depending on extra bit. Also includes an option to aim at the player's position.

Requested by crocodileman94.

name: smwsprites-upside-down-ninji
title: Upside-down Ninji
description:
This sprite is an upside-down Ninji.
You can set the movement flag and individual jumping power.

Request from Anorakun.

name: smwsprites-upside-down-volcano-lotus
title: Upside-down Volcano Lotus
description:
An upside-down Volcano Lotus.
Requires no additional graphics.

The pollen spread out faster than usual because of the nature of the pollen sprite that restricts horizontal movement while the pollen move down, but it should still work just fine for the same purposes as usual.
Maybe even a little better?

Actual spread speed can be adjusted in the .asm file.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

name: smwsprites-upwards-flying-star-sprite-v1
title: Upwards Flying Star Sprite v1.1
description:
This is my first serious custom sprite. It's a star sprite which flies up and stops at a certain position which you can easily set in the ASM file.
You could for example let it spawn out from a block, like with these.
The graphics work with the default palette A but be sure to give credit to BlackSquirrel for those.
I tried to document the ASM file as good as I could so there shouldn't be too much troubles by customizing it a bit.
No credit needed, just have fun with it. GFX goes in SP4

v1.1 Update:
- Added customisability options
- Fixed AMK compatibility
- Made the position to be set using the first two extra bytes
- Star gives points upon collection
- Removed extra graphics
- Replaced SA-1 defines to new one

name: smwsprites-urchin
title: Urchin
description:
This is a disassembly of sprites 3A and 3B in SMW, the non-wall-following Urchins. The extra bit determines which of the original sprites it acts like.

Update on 25/06/2023 by Burning Loaf
Changed the .cfg to a .json and added SA-1 support upon request from Green.

name: smwsprites-urchin-circular-motion
title: Urchin, Circular Motion
description: This Urchin moves in a circle in a direction controlled by the extra bit. The extra byte controls its radius.

name: smwsprites-venus-flyin-trap
title: Venus Flyin' Trap
description:
Venus Firetrap combines with the Jumpin' Piranha Plant to create this monstrosity.

Venus Flyin' Trap hides in a pipe and jumps out, fluttering a bit, before shooting a fireball or two and hiding back inside the pipe.

The Extra Bit determines how many fireballs are to be launched. Clear = 1 fireball, Set = 2 fireballs. It also changes the color of the sprite to match their respective functions in SMB3.

At the top of the asm file, there are some configurations for the projectile to be spawned (It can be determined manually, or by the extra property byte instead of spritenumber+1)

Also included is a proper 8x8 hitbox fireball sprite. This one bounces like a Fire Bros' fireball by default, but the extra bit can be used to make it go in a straight line like the Venus Firetrap's fireballs usually do.

Hope y'all have fun making level design happen with that!

Oh, and just in case, it includes the Venus Firetrap GFX file that is included with PIXI.

name: smwsprites-vertical-boo-stream-horizontal-wave-movement
title: Vertical Boo Stream, horizontal wave movement
description:
It's a Boo Steam that moves up/down with Left/Right Wave motion.
On Extra Bit Set it'll initially start moving right, otherwise it initially moves left.
It also uses first property byte for custom intitial Y speed (By default, it "Faces" Mario). More info in ASM.
Credit is optional.

versions.title: Vertical Boo Stream, horizontal wave movement

name: smwsprites-vertical-fireball-podoboo
title: Vertical Fireball / Podoboo
description: This is a disassembly of sprite 33 in SMW, the vertical fireball (or Podoboo, if you prefer).  I also included an alternate version that will be upside-down when the extra bit is set.

name: smwsprites-vertically-falling-bomb
title: Vertically falling bomb
description:
This sprite will fall to the ground and then explode if Mario comes nearby. If the extra bit is set, it tries to follow him too.

To be assembled with PIXI.

name: smwsprites-volcano-lotus
title: Volcano Lotus
description: This is a disassembly of sprite 99 in SMW - Volcano Lotus.

name: smwsprites-volcano-lotus-pollen
title: Volcano Lotus + Pollen
description:
A "disassembly" of the Volcano Lotus and its extended sprite pollen, to be inserted with PIXI.
Includes extra features, such as the ability to make the pollen homing, and a saner graphics routine.

name: smwsprites-waddle-dee
title: Waddle Dee
description:
The Waddle Dee from Kirby, a simple 16x16 sprite which will walk off ledges. Mario can jump on it to kill it.

Originally part of the Kirby Sprite Pack.

name: smwsprites-walking-key
title: Walking Key
description: A key that walks. When stomped, it turns into a regular key.

name: smwsprites-wall-following-exploding-sparky-hothead
title: Wall-Following Exploding Sparky/Hothead
description:
It's a Sparky/Hothead which follows walls except they explode when the player gets close to them.

Requested by RollingRigatonis

name: smwsprites-wall-following-grinder
title: Wall-Following Grinder
description:
This is a grinder that acts like a Hothead and follows along walls. If the extra bit is set, it'll attempt to chase Mario as well, though it doesn't account for blocks being in the way.

No credit necessary.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

name: smwsprites-wall-following-urchin
title: Wall-Following Urchin
description:
This is a disassembly of the Wall-following Urchin. Code from other wall-following sprites (spike top, hothead, etc.) has been cut out.

You can use this as a base for another wall-following sprite.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

name: smwsprites-wall-interacting-floating-skull-rafts
title: Wall-Interacting Floating Skull Rafts
description:
The original Skull Rafts, but they turn around when hitting a wall.

Based on the disassembly.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

name: smwsprites-wall-scaling-bullet-bill-shooter
title: Wall Scaling Bullet Bill Shooter
description: A Bullet Bill Shooter that scrolls up and down and stops to turn around when it hits the floor or ceiling. The extra bit can be set to make it shoot in Mario's direction (which also changes the palette), otherwise, its direction is determined by X position. Palettes and speeds are changable at the top of the ASM file.

name: smwsprites-wall-springboard-pea-bouncer-single-use
title: Wall Springboard (Pea Bouncer), Single Use
description:
This wall springboard / pea bouncer will fall off or shatter after a single use.

Requested by Knight of Time.

name: smwsprites-wall-springboards
title: Wall Springboards
description: This is a disassembly of sprites 6B and 6C in SMW, the wall springboards (or Pea Bouncers, if you prefer).  The extra bit determines which of the original sprites it acts like.

name: smwsprites-wallmaster
title: Wallmaster
description:
This is a hand sprite that acts like the ones found in some games of The Legend of Zelda series. Once in a while, it falls from the ceiling, trying to catch the player. If it succeeds, they're teleported. Extra Bytes 1 and 2 determine the first warp destination (used when the midway point isn't collected), and Extra Bytes 3 and 4 determine the second warp destination (used when the midway point is collected).

Includes tilemap defines, a free RAM define (whose address is required for some functions explained in the Readme file), defines for amount of time before the hand falls and for how long the hand should stand in place before closing, an option to respawn if killed with star or fireballs, and sound effect defines for falling and catching the player.

name: smwsprites-wanderin-goom
title: Wanderin' Goom
description:
Enclosed is Wonderin' Gooms from Wario Land 1.

Wanderin' Goom:
A small guy who looks like a cat. Takes 2 hits to kill. Shoots fire when extra bit is set (it's beta stuff from WL).

ExGFX included.

name: smwsprites-wario-dash
title: Wario Dash
description:
This sprite will give Mario the Wario Dash ability when he collects it.

While dashing (which replaces running), Mario's speed, pose, and colors change and he's invincible. He loses the ability if he gets hit or gets another powerup.

Because this sprite isn't a custom powerup, it requires UberASM to function. Check the readme for more information. Check the ASM files for customization options.

name: smwsprites-wario-land
title: Wario Land 1 Crab
description: This is the crab from Wario Land 1, a 16x16 sprite which always hurts Mario. It stays on ledges.

name: smwsprites-warp-star
title: Warp Star
description:
The warp star from Kirby. It will float in the air. When Mario touches it, it'll rise up along with him and teleport him to another level.

If set up correctly, Mario will be riding a star when he enters the other level. The star will fall and explode when it hits the ground.

Check the readme and the ASM files for information on how to link and place the star correctly.

Originally part of the Kirby Sprite Pack.

name: smwsprites-wart
title: Wart
description:
A recreation of Wart, the final boss from Super Mario Bros. 2.

Wart is a giant toad which will walk back and forth. He will occasionally open his mouth and shoot bubbles. A machine next to him spawns veggies, which can be picked up and thrown into Wart's open mouth to damage him. After 6 hits, the boss dies while slowly falling down. After dying, a door is created.

Read the included readme for instructions on inserting the boss.

Demonstration video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n5BxhjUIEMA

name: smwsprites-water-bubble
title: Water Bubble
description:
This is a disassembly of the Water Bubble extended sprite ($12).

It adds options to survive outside of water, or survive until offscreen.

name: smwsprites-water-droplet
title: Water Droplet
description: A very simple and decorative sprite which spawns itself in place and falls to the ground only to splat.

name: smwsprites-wave-muncher-launcher-jumping-muncher
title: Wave Muncher Launcher + Jumping Muncher
description:
FOREWARNING:
- Sprite Memory is recommended to be put on 10.

JumpingMuncher.asm is an enemy sprite that replaces the tile it is set on as it spawns, then jumps up, falls back down, and becomes a tile again.

WaveMuncherLauncher.asm spawns JumpingMunchers sequentially, from right to left.

The blocks affects settings of WaveMuncherLauncher as it passes them by, setting the height to spawn a JumpingMuncher on, or telling WaveMuncherLauncher to not spawn one.

Not very user-friendly; Readme.txt has implied instructions on how to use this.

Note: By default, WaveMuncherLauncher spawns custom sprite #$00.

25/11/2022
Made all blocks compatible with the latest version of GPS
Made Both included sprites compatible with the lastest version of Pixi
Removed unnecessary empty block files
Made compatible with lorom

name: smwsprites-wavy-torpedo-ted
title: Wavy Torpedo Ted
description:
This is a torpedo ted that have wavy movement, resembling Glad Torpedo Teds from Super Princess Peach.

Credit is unecessary. Requested by maro.

Tip: If you want to make it launch like original torpedo ted, use Torpedo Launcher.

name: smwsprites-whimp
title: Whimp
description:
As requested by Roberto Zampari, here's a Whimp sprite that behaves just like NSMB2's whomp. When mario reaches near, it jumps and, when it reaches the ground, it slaps the ground with its face.

In order to kill it, while it's lying on the ground, you must spinjump in it, and it'll break.

Credits go to Squishy Rex for drawing the graphics that come included.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

(Rykon-V73): Converted the sprite into a .json file. My version uses palette 9, but it can be changed, by changing every $03 from PROP: db $03,$03,$03,$03 to $0D. And added a .gif. Blame my laptop for the .gif.

name: smwsprites-wiggler
title: Wiggler
description:
This is a disassembly of the Wiggler sprite (86), commented and ready to be inserted with PIXI. It also works on SA-1 roms. Use it with the "forest" spriteset.
If the extra bit is set, it will spawn in the angry state. You can also change the number of segments using with the different .cfg files provided. Few other customizations are possible with the defines in the .asm file.

Note: the death animation of the vanilla wiggler is handled by calling the sprite's main code even if its state is "killed". Without some kind of patch, this won't be done for this sprite, so the wiggler will usually disappear abruptly when killed (see the second screenshot).

name: smwsprites-wild-mechakoopa-v1
title: Wild Mechakoopa v1.1
description:
This Mechakoopa hops around with customisable period and maximum height. If the extra bit is set, the Mechakoopa will explode instead of recover after begin stunned.

Includes a lot of defines to customise:

-Custom palette for the extra bit version.

-Expanded palettes for the recovering animation (up to 8 different palettes).

-Customisable recovery time.

And a lot more. Check out the readme for the details

Based on imamelia's dissasembly of the Mechakoopa.

v1.1

What's changed:

-Now SA-1 hybrid.
-Added three extra bytes to customise the mechakoopa Y speed, X speed and palette.
-Fixed sprite-sprite interaction so now the mechakoopa updates his speed even in the air when interacting with another sprite.

name: smwsprites-winged-cloud
title: Winged Cloud
description:
This is the Winged Cloud from Yoshi's Island.
It's... a winged cloud. You can throw a projectile at it or hit it with the Cape or a Fireball to make it drop its contents or trigger a small scene where select tiles are changed into other tiles, to create a bridge for example.

The "trigger" itself is an invisible sprite which may either spawn a Growing Vine in its place, or it'll lock the screen and begin changing certain Map16 tiles to other tiles.
A sample level is included to showcase how it is more or less used in the preview GIF.

A custom Coin sprite is also included, as some settings utilize it to spawn multiple coins. Standard Sprite 21 (the Moving Coin) does not work well for these purposes.

Release History:
- 7/9/2023: V1.0 (C3 2023) - Initial Release.

name: smwsprites-winged-thwomp
title: Winged Thwomp
description:
A Thwomp with wings that can either fly in a specified range or go on forever horizontally. Check the ASM file for more customization options.

Update (KevinM): converted to PIXI.

name: smwsprites-wooden-spike
title: Wooden Spike
description:
A disassembly of the wooden spikes (sprites AC and AD). The extra bit determines which of the two original sprites it acts like: see the ASM file for more information.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

name: smwsprites-woozy-guy
title: Woozy Guy
description:
This is a type of Shy Guy that moves forward by doing small jumps, doing flips in the air.

The extra bit will determine the size: it will be 16x16 if clear and 32x32 if set.

Originally from smkdan's Yoshi's Island dynamic sprites pack.

name: smwsprites-wreckin-chuck
title: Wreckin' Chuck
description:
A spiritual recreation of the first boss from Sonic the Hedgehog 1, featuring a Chargin' Chuck.
The boss swings a large Ball & Chain attempting to hit the player. You can either jump over it or try to ride it with a spin jump.

The boss can be damaged by a stomp or a thrown sprite. Thrown sprites can collide with either the Chuck or the ship itself. Hitting the ship will (by default) do less damage than hitting the Chuck.

The sprite also contains "gib" and "smoke" cluster sprites, which are used in the defeat sequence. They aren't required for the sprite to function (and as such you can just set their sprite #s to $FF to prevent spawning them altogether if needed).

NOTE: Due to how collision works in SMW, if the ball goes off the left border of the screen while in screen 0, Mario might just phase through it.
It's intended to be placed later in the level as in the source game.

Mod edit 2024-3-24: Renamed one of the included routines to avoid a name conflict with Pixi 1.40+
Mod edit 2026-2-20: Added STZ !1510,x to init to fix a common bug with the pendulum.

name: smwsprites-x-y-position-locked-sprite-v1
title: X/Y Position Locked Sprite v1.2
description:
This sprite will spawn another sprite and lock it to Mario's X or Y position.

Extra bit: clear = vanilla, set = custom.

Extra byte 1: sprite number to spawn.

Extra byte 2: X/Y offset from Mario to keep the sprite at. For example, use $F8 with the Hammer Brother's platform to have Mario centered on the platform.

Extra byte 3: if the lowest bit is not set, the sprite will target the X position, otherwise it'll target the Y position. Additionally, if the highest bit is set, it'll set the extra bit for the spawned sprite.

Extra bytes 4-7: these 4 values set the 4 extra bytes for the spawned sprite (if custom).

Updates:
- v1.1: added Y follow setting.
- v1.2: now the sprite uses 7 extra bytes so you can set the extra bytes for the spawned sprite. Also added an option to set the extra bit for the spawned sprite.

name: smwsprites-yellow-parakoopa-wave-motion
title: Yellow Parakoopa, Wave Motion
description:
A complete remake of my old yellow Parakoopa.
This is a parakoopa which flies in wave motion instead of being just a normal koopa with wings and more hits. The extra bit controls whether it follows the player, like an ordinary yellow Koopa.

name: smwsprites-yi-ball-n-chain
title: YI Ball 'n' Chain
description:
This long ball 'n' chain sprite rotates around a block. Both the chain and the ball hurt Mario. It is perfect for castles.

Requires the No More Sprite Tile Limits patch.

name: smwsprites-yi-big-boo
title: YI Big Boo
description:
The 32x32 sized Boo from SMW2:YI.

This sprite was part of smkdan's YI Pack 2, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

name: smwsprites-yi-bill-blaster-bullet-bill
title: YI Bill Blaster & Bullet Bill
description:
This is the Bill Blaster from Yoshi's Island, along with that smiling Bullet Bill. What's special about it is that before shooting it has a dynamic animation where it expands, and the Bullet Bill is larger than the Super Mario World's one.

Originally from smkdan's Yoshi's Island dynamic sprites pack.

name: smwsprites-yi-blow-hard-v2
title: YI Blow Hard v2.2
description:
A Cactus-like sprite from Yoshi's Island that fires needlenoses

Updated to fix three Yoshi interaction glitches.
2020 update: Now properly SA-1 compatible. Fixed inaccurate aiming and glitchy flashing GFX in SA-1 ROMs.

**REQUIRES MANUAL GFX INSERTION** Not anymore.

name: smwsprites-yi-chomp-rock
title: YI Chomp Rock
description:
The Chomp Rock from Yoshi's Island. Mario can walk up to it and push it to start rolling it. It will kill sprites in its way and can be used as a stepping stone.

This version is not dynamic and has a more choppy animation. It consumes the entirety of SP4.

Check the ASM file for customization options.

name: smwsprites-yi-chomp-rock-dynamic-version-v1
title: YI - Chomp Rock (Dynamic Version) V1.2
description:
Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island - Chomp Rock (Dynamic Version):

Description: A pushable rock from YI that kills enemies when it touches them.

Please, for further information, check the included "Readme" file!

30/10/24: V1.2 Update maded by TheXander, Requested by Link13:
SA-1 Compatibility.
JSON Support.
Documentantion (Readme) File.
(.mw3) Converted to (.pal & palmask).

name: smwsprites-yi-cutscene-kamek-v1
title: YI Cutscene Kamek v1.0
description:
Recreation of Kamek during the boss cutscenes in Yoshi's Island.

There's some cool features such as:
  • Up to four consecutive SMW dialog boxes
  • VWF Dialogues support
  • Several magic wave colors
  • Magic waves API so you can use those outside of the Kamek sprite


Keep in mind that this does NOT implement any sort of sprite stretching like in the original game, this is more suited towards people creating their own cutscenes.

This resource was made as a public commissioned work.

name: smwsprites-yi-dizzy-dandy
title: YI Dizzy Dandy
description: A flower that falls and rolls towards mario when he gets near it. It also kills enemies.

name: smwsprites-yi-dynamic-door-v1
title: YI Dynamic Door (v1.1)
description:
A door from YI with an opening+closing animation. It's best for castles because Yoshi is incompatible with this sprite.

Included are:
1. Dynamic Door (normal / boss depending on extra bit)
2. Extra Doors (locked / blocked depending on extra bit)

NOTE: this slightly updated version fixes a glitch that occurs while teleporting from a level that was entered via pipe.

name: smwsprites-yi-floating-rock
title: YI Floating Rock
description:
This rock, found in 3-7, floats on the water. If stood on, it tilts to the side and you slip off. Make sure to enable sprite buoyancy.

1.1 update: SA-1 compatibility. For lorom, delay before reading multiply and divide results.

name: smwsprites-yi-flopsy-fish-constant-jumping
title: YI Flopsy Fish (constant jumping)
description:
A fish from YI that constantly jumps out of the water (read the readme for more info on various options)

v1.1: update for PIXI and SA-1 compatibility (spooonsss)

name: smwsprites-yi-flying-kamek
title: YI Flying Kamek
description:
This is the flying Kamek sprite used in a few levels of Yoshi's Island, which flies in a loop from the background to the foreground.

It starts by moving left in the background at whatever height you place it at in Lunar Magic. Once it goes offscreen, it'll fly right in the foreground starting at Mario's height. When it goes offscreen there, it'll go back to the BG.

Graphics for the original Kamek sprite are included, as well.

name: smwsprites-yi-hootie-the-bluefish-piranha-fish
title: YI Hootie the Bluefish (Piranha Fish)
description:
This is based off the wall-following Urchin. It is the purple wall-following piranha plant in Naval Piranha's castle. Unlike the one in YI, this one is not compatible with slopes, so plan around that.

It requires manual GFX insertion, refer to the README. It doesn't requires it anymore, just insert it with piranhafishgfx.bin at the same folder as piranha_fish.cfg.

name: smwsprites-yi-hootie-the-bluefish-piranha-fish-not-dynamic
title: YI Hootie the Bluefish (Piranha Fish) - not dynamic
description: Someone wanted a non-dynamic version of the piranha fish... so I made one since I was bored.

versions.title: YI Hootie the Bluefish (Piranha Fish) - not dynamic

name: smwsprites-yi-melon-bug
title: YI Melon Bug
description:
The helpful/abuseable pillbug-like critters from Yoshi's Island. Curls up into a ball if the player startles it or touches it, and can be picked up and thrown or kicked around, killing any enemies it rolls over.

If the player lets it roll, it will build up momentum on slopes, giving the player a nice shove depending on how fast it goes. (Occasionally, it will push the player so fast that the player cannot jump. Use the Player X Speed Fix patch if this is a problem.)

By default, the sprite is able to be jumped on, like in the Super Donkey prototypes. Change the define "!Stompable" to 0 if you want this interaction to more closely resemble Yoshi's Island (the player can only push it and be pushed, even from the top).

This sprite is also compatible with Yoshi, shell-less blue Koopas, and the purple triangles.

OBLIGATORY SLOPE DISCLAIMER:
This sprite is designed to work in tandem with slopes, arguably the most broken mechanic in this already broken game. At the speeds this sprite tends to go at, it has a non-zero chance to clip through steep slopes as it bounces slightly off the ground. Until we get a "Sprite Slope Pass Glitch Fix" patch, this issue can be worked around by setting the define "!BouncesOffGround" to 0.

name: smwsprites-yi-nipper-and-dandelion
title: YI Nipper and Dandelion
description:
Yoshi's island Dandelion parachute, spawns a sprite after touching the ground.

the palette and the sprite it spawns can also be customized with the extra bytes.

also comes with the YI nipper plant and a cluster sprite for the smoke.

check the ASM file for details on how to use the sprite

requested by Rykon-V73

2022-05-25:
added a option to decrease the amount of cluster smoke that the dandelion spawns

converted some ram addresses I missed, the sprites should properly work on sa-1 now.

added a delay for the nippers (this can be toggled off in the ASM file)

name: smwsprites-yi-o-spike
title: YI O-Spike
description: This the cactus-like enemy from YI that rolls toward mario if a shell hits it on the low side, but rolls away if it's hit on the upper side.

name: smwsprites-yi-smb3-spike-non-dynamic
title: YI/SMB3 Spike (non-dynamic)
description: A spike that throws spiked balls just like in YI/SMB3. Extra bit + CFG palette allows it to behave similarly to the SMW shelless Koopas.

name: smwsprites-yi-spike
title: YI Spike
description: This is similar to the SMB3 spike, except that the ball it throws is "dynamic", 32x32, it "grows" out of its mouth, and spins as it's in the air.

name: smwsprites-yi-stretch
title: YI Stretch
description:
The vertically stretched Shyguy from SMW2:YI.

This sprite was part of smkdan's YI Pack 2, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

name: smwsprites-yi-wild-ptooie-non-dynamic-v1
title: YI Wild Ptooie (non-dynamic) v1.1
description:
The wild piranha plant from SMW2:YI which spits needlenoses. The projectile is included.

This sprite was part of smkdan's YI Pack 3, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

v1.1
-----
Fixed a bug with SA1, RAM that checks if yellow needle is in yoshi's mouth wasn't using pixi's define, it was using the plain RAM which doesn't work on sa-1.
Minor fix, still a fix.

name: smwsprites-yi-wild-ptooie-piranha-plant-v3
title: YI Wild Ptooie & Piranha Plant v3.1
description:
YI Wild Piranha Plant v3.0:
This is my second time re-coding this sprite. It now uses "gradual" rotation when hit instead of directly setting the value. It shares GFX with the Ptooie.

YI Wild Ptooie v3.0:
This is my first time coding the Wild Ptooie, but there were already two versions made by smkdan. The main features in this one are: "gradual" rotation, scaling head when tracking, and facing-down frames.

Includes a document on how to customize the Wild Ptooie

v3.1 (spooonsss): convert to asar and pixi. Support for SA-1.

versions.title: YI Wild Ptooie & Piranha Plant v3.1
versions.filename: YI Wild Ptooie and Piranha Plant v3.1.zip

name: smwsprites-yi-winged-item-cloud
title: YI Winged Item Cloud
description: This is the flying cloud from YI that contains an item. You can customize which sprite is spawned by modifying the extra property bytes. It is triggered with a shell or a stunned enemy. It comes with some pre-configured CFG files that spawn certain items.

name: smwsprites-yoshi-eggs
title: Yoshi Eggs
description:
A custom Yoshi Egg sprite that's based on the original sprite through disassembly. Comes with:

When the extra bit is set it will only hatch if the corresponding switch palace has been activated.

This can only be inserted with PIXI. More details in the readme.

name: smwsprites-yoshi-house-birds
title: Yoshi House Birds
description:
The bird sprite in Yoshi's House, ready to be inserted with Romi's version of Sprite Tool.

To be assembled with PIXI

name: smwsprites-yoshi-s-egg-breaks-on-thrown-objects
title: Yoshi's egg, breaks on thrown objects
description:
This yoshi egg only hatches when hit by thrown objects, like shells, thrown blocks and etc.

Credit is optional.

versions.title: Yoshi's egg, breaks on thrown objects
versions.filename: Yoshi Egg%2C breakable by thrown objects.zip

name: smwsprites-yoshi-s-fireball
title: Yoshi's Fireball
description: This is a disassembly of extended sprite 11 in SMW, Yoshi's Fireball.

name: smwsprites-yoshi-s-house-smoke
title: Yoshi's House Smoke
description: This is a disassembly of sprite 8B in SMW, the puff of smoke that comes from the chimney of Yoshi's House.

versions.title: Yoshi's House Smoke
versions.filename: SMWSDIS - sprite 8B - Yoshi%27s House smoke puff.zip

name: smwsprites-yoshi-s-island-arrow-lift
title: Yoshi's Island - Arrow Lift
description:
The spinning arrow from YI that can be ridden in the direction it's pointing in when it's stood on. You can customise for how long the platform stays alive after standing on as well as whether it rotates fast or slow.

Updated on request by Knight of Time

name: smwsprites-yoshi-s-island-p-switch
title: Yoshi's Island P-Switch
description:
It's a large red P-Switch the player can't carry nor move it somehow. When pressed a dynamic squishing animation will be played before exploding and activating the switch effect.

The extra bit determines if it behaves like a blue P-Switch (clear) or a silver P-Switch (set).

Originally from smkdan's Yoshi's Island dynamic sprite pack.

name: smwsprites-yoshi-s-island-style-door-version-1
title: Yoshi's Island-Style Door (Version 1.0)
description: Just like in YI, this door will open up, then warp you, and you can't move until after the door warps you, if you open it! Comes with a graphics file for the door.

name: smwsprites-yoshi-s-island-style-shy-guy
title: Yoshi's Island-style Shy Guy
description:
This is a Shy Guy that behaves like the one in Yoshi's Island.

(Rykon-V73): Added .json file for the 2 sprites and merged its GFX with the Fly Guy GFX. Now both should be compatible.

name: smwsprites-yurarin-boo
title: Yurarin Boo
description:
A seahorse from Super Mario Land that jumps from water, spits a fireball, and stays behind layers. It can be stomped. Don't forget to enable sprite buoyancy for your level if using this sprite.

This sprite was part of smkdan's Super Mario Land sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

name: smwsprites-zidane-bro
title: Zidane Bro.
description:
This sprite was made as a joke, but some of you might find him useful I guess.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PpXxpMoTwQk
